name: Apogee
description: A cinematic research-concept site with a planetary opening, interactive mission index, searchable field archive, and three mission pages.

notes.layout: monumental planetary opening, compact mission strip, vertical mission selector, horizon spread, searchable archive
notes.motion: image hover and reduced-motion-aware anchor scrolling
notes.interaction: switch missions, search and filter studies, save locally, explore keyboard-accessible research stages
notes.provenance: Original five-page coded concept informed by space-site references. Own composition, identity, content, and interactions; one generated planet and two credited NASA images.
